pr.title: Improve all-moduli Dirichlet boundary to 0.874830
pr.body:
QRH-Result: gao-balanced-marked-20261017
QRH-Bound: 87483/100000
QRH-Decimal: 0.874830

Proves that every Dirichlet L-function is nonzero for Re(s) > 0.874830, with the principal pole excluded. The proof retains the common geometric surplus inside source energies, uses density-adaptive marked moments, and combines two affine source planes in the detector count while choosing the numerator moment separately. It uses the accepted 0.874836 theorem for the incumbent feedback.

[Paper (4 pages)](https://github.com/Gaozhongpai/QuasiRiemannTracker/blob/ee7be4e7f4aae2835610fe3a5d620dbe3a1b6791/papers/gao-balanced-marked-20261017/paper.pdf) · [TeX source](https://github.com/Gaozhongpai/QuasiRiemannTracker/blob/ee7be4e7f4aae2835610fe3a5d620dbe3a1b6791/papers/gao-balanced-marked-20261017/paper.tex) · [Canonical Lean theorem](https://github.com/Gaozhongpai/QuasiRiemannTracker/blob/52419a826d4a8465cdeb56aaa2d471c489221d1d/submissions/gao-balanced-marked-20261017/src/Candidate/Main.lean)

Validation: all 405 new supporting modules and the complete `Candidate.bound` passed local Lean checks with accepted cached dependencies, using only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. Official metadata and import-closure checks pass. Local full replay was skipped; GitHub's exact-head replay, Comparator, and independent-kernel checks remain to run.

The paper is linked from its permanent companion commit so that this result PR contains only the required submission files. The submission includes the minimal required predecessor source closure, byte-identical to the accepted source, because those `Candidate` modules are not exported as reusable submission modules. Existing submissions are unchanged. Attribution to OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Akash Levy, timbalud, DaysSky and previous Gao contributions is retained in the metadata, paper and source notices. Zhongpai Gao, with AI assistance.
